result.summary: Found 2 issues. The main one is that the active 'Pizza' filter does not match the listed restaurants. There is also a minor styling inconsistency between the favorite buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as selected (dark filled state), but the content does not reflect it. 'Fastest near you' lists a poké bowl place, a burger restaurant and an Italian trattoria. 'Popular right now' leads with 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' (cuisine: Ramen). Only the partly visible second card looks pizza-related. Either the filter is not applied or the chip's selected state is wrong.
issues.suggestion: Make the selected chip state match the applied filter. Selecting 'Pizza' should show only pizza restaurants in these sections, or the sections should be hidden or relabelled. Otherwise, reset the chip to 'All' when unfiltered content is shown.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently. On the pizza card the heart sits in a clearly visible dark circular container. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart appears without a comparable visible container, so the two controls look different.
issues.suggestion: Use one heart button style for all cards, with the same container shape, size, background opacity and position, so it stays legible on any image.
